name: broad-data-v1
status: Fixed-budget fit and development evaluation completed; final gameplay testing pending; no confidence claim
candidate_family: Existing 381600-parameter routed student; warm start, unchanged inference architecture

training.source_domains: Licensed high-resolution images rendered through the existing hidden sample
training.teacher: Unchanged native runtime, actual full-1920x1080 input/output capture

initial_fit.trainable: Existing refinement stage; first stage remains frozen
initial_fit.selection: Evaluate the completed fixed-budget fit; do not select a checkpoint using final tests

development.use: Track learning and regressions; may guide development, never used for final reliability claims
development.deduplication: Exact content hashes and DCT perceptual similarity against all selected and previously used original images; visual inspection before fitting

final_gameplay_test.unit: One independently selected 10-second gameplay sequence, not an individual frame
final_gameplay_test.target_domain: Wuthering Waves under the specified hardware, settings, resolution and native-teacher control configuration
final_gameplay_test.independence: No overlapping footage, crops of the same footage, repeated event or near-duplicate scene counted as another trial. Group related scene/event recordings together and sample one; independence must be justified in the final manifest.
final_gameplay_test.sampling: Predefine the intended gameplay distribution and sample independent scene/event groups from it. Targeted stress cases are scored separately; do not treat a convenient balanced image collection as random gameplay.
final_gameplay_test.reference_pairing: Same input, controls, exposure, frame sequence and temporal history for native teacher and candidate
final_gameplay_test.visual_review: Randomize A/B labels, use identical display conversion, inspect full sequence and matching native-size crops. No amplified difference image is the sole pass/fail criterion.
final_gameplay_test.failure_rule: Any noticeable loss of detail, wrong structure/color/lighting, flicker, ghosting, disocclusion artifact, or UI corruption relative to the native teacher fails the entire clip. Ambiguous or unreviewed cases remain unresolved and do not count as passes.
final_gameplay_test.zero_failure_acceptance: All 300 trials pass the predefined criterion. Under the independence and representative-sampling assumptions, the one-sided 95% exact binomial lower bound on pass rate exceeds 99%.
final_gameplay_test.if_failures_occur: Report actual successes, failures and the exact confidence bound; do not silently replace failures, lower the criterion, or stop after a convenient number of successes.
final_gameplay_test.if_model_changes: Previously inspected final cases become development data; collect an untouched final set for the changed candidate.
